chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in a woman entering ihram while wearing gold and khazz, and nothing is disliked except pure silk.

key_terms.الْخَزِّ: khazz, a mixed fabric traditionally containing silk
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the female pilgrim in this ruling
key_terms.تُحْرِمَ: to enter the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What may a woman wear during ihram according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding what a woman may wear in the state of ihram. It permits gold and khazz for women, while indicating dislike only for pure silk.
